{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nData types:\n", df.dtypes)
print("\nFirst few rows:\n", df.head(3).to_string(index=False))

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for missing age (sentinel -1)
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {len(missing_age)}")

# Check revenue column: is it really text?
print("\nSample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
